faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.body: The short answers to what people ask first.

pay.question: How do I pay, and are there fees?
pay.answer: There are no service fees. Most helpers are paid directly once the task is done. If a helper asks to be paid upfront, you pay when you book, plus a small hold fee, and TasksNearMe holds it until you say the task is done.

address.question: Who can see my address?
address.answer: Only the helper you book, once the booking is confirmed. Everyone else sees the general area.

verified.question: How are helpers checked?
verified.answer: Every helper passes an ID check before sending offers. In-home tasks, like cleaning and assembly, also need a background check.

rebook.question: Can I book the same helper again?
rebook.answer: Yes. Save a helper after a booking and use Book again to send them a new request.

helper.question: Can I post tasks and help others too?
helper.answer: Yes. One account can do both: switch between asking for help and helping.
